records.text: Stat priority for gear and Daevanion paths is in the Build tab (right edge).
Hold 4 to charge Hellfire, then let go: a full charge does three times the damage of charge 1. A macro fires it at charge 1, so press it yourself. Use it while Bittercold Wind roots the pack.

requires.note: Hellfire is learned at Lv 14; the step shows from then on.

records.text: Leveling loop. Bittercold Wind roots your target, then Firestorm and Blaze on the marked target, with Flame Arrow as the filler that restores MP. On a pack, Ice Chain and Winter's Shackles (from Lv 8) slow it.

requires.note: Blaze is learned at Lv 4, the last skill the loop needs (Bittercold Wind Lv 3); the step shows from then on.

records.text: Three skills only fire on a condition. Blaze hits only a target under Fire Mark, which your Fire attacks put on it. Flame Scattershot (from Lv 5) hits only a staggered target, Frost Burst (from Lv 10) only a target under Frost, which Frost (from Lv 7) puts on it.

requires.note: Blaze is learned at Lv 4 (Flame Scattershot Lv 5, Frost Burst Lv 10); the step shows from then on.

records.text: Complete "Urgent Pursuit" to unlock the [[tip:daevanion|Daevanion board]]. Use all your [[item:crystal]] from the Cube. Nodes are in the Daevanion board card at the top. [[build:text:nezekan-plan]]

records.text: Equip [[stigma:1]]. Plan: [[build:stigma:1]], raised to level [[build:stigmaTarget:1]] first. Any stigma fits any slot; if you equipped another, pick it in the Stigmas card.

all.note: Today's code (stigmaSlots / rankNext need g22:0 ticked for every slot), moved into the data. Stigmas via Asahr after "The One Who Hears the Voice": STORY_UNLOCKS. Whether slot 1 opens at Lv 22 alone is owner check 3.

proposed.change: None by itself: it keeps the live story atom and adds the code rule "slots wait for g22:0"; with derived g22:0 the slot opens once "Daeva in a Dream" is turned in, without the tick.
proposed.basis: prereq-gates §8; mirrors the 0.2 code rule, but rests on a legacy atom and open owner check 3 (does the stigma system wait for "The One Who Hears the Voice"?)
